title: Azusawa Kohane — Our Last Practice〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's nothing to do...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Normally, we'd all be practicing somewhere together...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's so much I wanted to tell you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You were supposed to meet Kohane...! And Akito and Toya...! You were supposed to tell me I'd found the best team ever...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And you were supposed to see the moment we did it...! When we surpassed RAD WEEKEND...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Tears of sorrow*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We decided to not give up and keep going, but An... I hope she's okay...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The person she loved and looked up to...is gone...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She seemed to be feeling a little better when we left... I wonder if it'd be okay to message her now...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Worrying isn't going to fix anything, so I should just...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, a message...!
It's from An!

rows.Speaker: An's Message
rows.Line: <Sorry about making you guys worry yesterday. My throat still hurts, but emotionally I'm feeling much better!>

rows.Speaker: An's Message
rows.Line: <You guys rest up too since we all put ourselves through the grinder!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An...
Thank goodness. She does seem much better...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, but... She could also be trying not to make us all worry about her...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I hope she really is feeling better...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But if I were to ask how she's really feeling, she'd probably just say she's okay...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What do I do in this situation...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, another message...
From Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Message
rows.Line: <If you're trying not to make us worry, please don't. I believe it's okay to put yourself first in these situations.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Aoyagi's never afraid of saying things like that... I need to say something too.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
<Thank you for messaging us, An.
You also try to rest since we know you put your throat through a lot.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Also, feel free to let me know if you want to talk. I'll be at home for the rest of today...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Send.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's hard not to dwell on things or let negative thoughts creep in when you're all by yourself... Like I was doing just now...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So if she ever wants to talk...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A call...?
Oh!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Morning, Kohane.
Surprised?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, a little.
I mean, I just sent my reply to you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Haha. You did say that I could call you whenever. So, I called. Are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I can talk.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Thanks. I was actually just helping open up the cafe. It's really nice out today.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...? You're helping out today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Yeah. My dad said that I didn't have to, but with nothing else to do, I was having trouble getting yesterday out of my head.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you too?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was feeling the same way, and I thought that having someone to talk to would take my mind off things.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <And that's why you said that we could talk whenever? You really are like the nicest person ever, Kohane.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <So, is it okay if we talk until I have to start serving customers?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Wait, no. I need to thank Toya first!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. Take your time.
I'm not going anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I hope I can help take her mind off things even just a little.)
